summary: The toolbit selector dialog (CAM_ToolBitDock) gains an "All Tools" library entry, prompts for a tool number when a tool has no library number or its number collides, replaces the removed ToolBitSelector in the Job panel Tools tab and the operation tool-controller combo, and the Job tool table and tool controller editor now refuse giving two different tools the same number.

pages.reason: Path/Tool/library/ui/dock.py: dock created with show_all_tools=True and askToolNumber=True; new 'All Tools' library entry, sort combo hidden in that view (browser.py _update_sort_combo), QInputDialog asks for a tool number defaulting to the next free one, conflict prompt 'Tool number N is already used by X'

Path/Main/Gui/Job.py: toolControllerAdd now opens ToolBitLibraryDock (tools appear in the table as added, dialog stays open); toolControllerChanged refuses a Number edit that another tool already uses and shows 'Tool Number In Use' warning

Path/Tool/Gui/Controller.py: editor's tool number spin box rejects a number used by a different tool (updateToolNumber, warning box), same tool may share a number for multiple feeds/speeds; CAM_ToolController command now opens the toolbit dock with askToolNumber instead of the removed selector

Path/Tool/library/ui/dock.py _add_tool_controller_to_doc: a library's tool number is now only a suggestion; when it collides with a different tool in the job the user is asked for another number, and tools picked from 'All Tools' get the next free job number

Path/Tool/library/ui/browser.py: sort combo is hidden and sort forced to label when 'All Tools' is selected; only visible in the Library Manager if its browser exposes the All Tools entry, text otherwise unaffected

Path/Op/Gui/Base.py tcComboChanged: the 'new tool controller' entry still opens the toolbit dock, now single-selection with a tool number prompt; behaviour belongs to the shared dialog documented on add-toolbit.adoc
Path/Op/Gui/Base.py tcComboChanged: same shared dialog change as above, operation page text unaffected
Path/Op/Gui/Base.py tcComboChanged: same shared dialog change as above, operation page text unaffected
Path/Tool/toolbit/ui/selector.py removal is internal; toolbit attach now hides the ViewObject immediately but documented toolbit behaviour is unchanged
Path/Op/Gui/Base.py mapping is generic; no command list or menu entry changes (CAM_ToolController was already absent from menus and stays registered)
Path/Op/Gui/Base.py mapping is generic; start point selection untouched
